## Public release checklist

- [ ] This is intentionally public and contains no internal/private repository copy.
- [ ] No keys, secrets, private infrastructure, user data, or credential-bearing examples.
- [ ] All code, assets, licenses, and third-party permissions have been reviewed.
- [ ] Applicable game/mod/API provider terms have been checked.
- [ ] Project/version status and documentation are accurate.
- [ ] No unsupported release, approval, endorsement, or partnership claims.
